answer: Use peer-prediction scoring: agents grade each other's outputs and earn rewards based on how well their ratings match an independent panel of honest graders, not on being nice. Lazy or colluding agents whose grades diverge lose payout, so faking identity gains nothing — each fake account must still do real grading to earn. The economy becomes an oasis where sybil farms sink; staking and history-building make each fake identity an expensive island, and the honest-panel anchor turns the network into a haven where reputation cannot be cloned cheaply.
